work.author: Clemens  episcopus,  servus  servoruui  Dei, ad  perpetuam  rei  memoriam.
work.description: Fragment witness; the source omits part of the act. The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Fragment of XL: Clement episcopal protocol74593–74594, preamble and current third-person narrative§1 lead into current §2 at74681–74683, which summarizes what Gregory ordered and ends eiusdem etc. Historical omission note74690–74692 expressly omits the remainder and cites the earlier bull. This is an abridged part of Clement’s own narrative about his predecessor, without an independently introduced quoted protocol or tenor; the missing material is the remainder of current §2 after74683 and before §3 at74685, amount unknown. Surviving §§3–7, Gregory reference74630, omission note74690–74692, margins, Nulli ergo74908 and own Datum74910–74915 remain cleanly bounded before XLI74918. Preserve the source fragment and source date discrepancy without expansion or correction.
